featureReviews.notes: Five material families read apart as in the reference: muted brown bench wood with long grain (two UV orientations), a mid steel-grey blade, a dark warm-grey iron hub and nut, a greyer brown log and its pale peach cut face, plus the dark slot. Albedos come from the material-evidence palettes; region means land within dE 3-8 of the reference (_lib/region_compare.py) and the per-part colour gate is 16.2. The steel still lacks its brushed sheen (surface pass).
Tier-1 IoU 0.890, aspect 0.006, scale 0.006; the log lies turned toward the viewer on the top.

Toothed blade with hub, nut and slot; base colour within dE 7 of the reference's blade region. Still flat with linear streaks where the reference has a bright brushed sheen and rim: surface-pass work.
Muted brown wood (front face within dE 3 of the reference), grain along the top boards and up the legs, darker shadowed members under the top.
After the refine the log rests fully on the top, turned toward the viewer, with its cut face lit pale peach (region within dE 8 of the reference's) and no overhang shadow.

summary: Material pass after one refine-spec: evidence-based albedos, long-grain material, the log resting on the top with a lit pale cut face. Tier-1 IoU 0.890, aspect 0.006, scale 0.006, per-part colour max dE 16.2 (gate 20) with the render's five colour clusters matching the reference's; all orbit gates pass.
matched: muted brown wood with grain along boards and legs
mid-grey blade, dark iron hub and nut
log on the top with a pale peach cut face toward the viewer
colour clusters line up with the reference's
mismatches: blade flat with linear streaks, no brushed sheen or bright rim (surface-pass)
wood lacks the reference's soft edge highlights and worn edges (surface-pass)
specFixes: surface-pass: blade sheen (lower roughness, softer streaks), edge wear and grain contrast on the wood, bark streaks on the log
